query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((r."PLANNED_DATE" <= :p_as_of) AND ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RELEASED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PICKED'))) AND (r."QUANTITY" > 0) THEN (0 + r."QUANTITY") ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."PLANT") = RTRIM(:p_plant)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::DELIVERY_BACKLOG" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "PLANT" NVARCHAR(4), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "PLANNED_DATE" NVARCHAR(8), "QUANTITY" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_plant NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_as_of NVARCHAR(8),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((r."PLANNED_DATE" <= :p_as_of) AND ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RELEASED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PICKED'))) AND (r."QUANTITY" > 0) THEN (0 + r."QUANTITY") ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."PLANT") = RTRIM(:p_plant)));
END;

semantics.characterComparison: RTRIM preserves ABAP fixed-character trailing-space comparison
semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
